sub_agent_reviews.summary: One unified Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety, then recommended arXiv:2608.11392v1.
Full PDF and reproducibility repository README were read; Markdown explains mechanism, experiments, results, judge failures, and limits.
W/G/D/X taxonomy, replay protocol, Table 2/3/4 evidence, and repo layout were incorporated.
Boundaries are explicit: single-cycle scope, synthetic data, prohibition-only rules, salience confound, replay-model limits, and judge dependence.
Related context includes Governance Decay, long-context safety degradation, constraint pinning, and commitment-preserving compression.
Chinese Markdown passed the 5000 Han-character gate and uses tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid with no external image references.
